glosses: character; the totality of someone's personal qualities
character, characteristic feature or nature of a thing, place, or people

examples.text: Er ist ein Mann von Charakter.
examples.en: He is a man of character.

examples.text: Ihr Charakter hat sich vollkommen geändert.
examples.en: She has totally changed her character.

examples.text: Alle Charaktere dieses Buches sind erfunden.
examples.en: All the characters in this book are imaginary.
